title: Monomial of a permutation matching
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The monomial associated with $\sigma$ has exponent $1$ on each variable indexed by $(i,\sigma(i))$ and exponent $0$ on every other variable.
